name: codegate
description: Gate-enforced completion for OpenCode 2: a fork of opencode-orchestrator that ends a mission only when approved, re-executed acceptance gates pass.
author: agnusdei1207 (upstream); CodeGate changes by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Anthropic)

scripts.docker:build-all: docker compose run --rm dev && docker compose run --rm rust-arm64 && docker compose run --rm win-builder
scripts.docker:rust-dist: docker compose run --rm dev && docker compose run --rm rust-arm64
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run docker:rust-dist
scripts.release:patch: node scripts/release-version.mjs patch && npm run release:preflight && npm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: node scripts/release-version.mjs minor && npm run release:preflight && npm run release:push
scripts.release:major: node scripts/release-version.mjs major && npm run release:preflight && npm run release:push
scripts.release:clean: node -e "for (const dir of ['dist', 'bin']) require('node:fs').rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })" && docker compose down -v
